application.name: maestro
application.primary_user: A developer supervising model-assisted work in a local repository
application.core_task: Inspect, direct, approve, and verify agent work without leaving the terminal

screens.purpose: Direct the active agent, read its transcript, and inspect current decisions and progress
Inspect repository files, staged proposals, diffs, and focused agent context
Confirm or cancel the execute approved tool operation after showing its exact target and arguments
Confirm or cancel the apply proposal operation after reviewing the affected path and hunks
Select an available provider model and reasoning effort for the active role
Show discoverable keyboard controls for the current workspace

keybindings.action: cancel active task or quit when idle
cancel active task and close transient surface
insert portable newline in IDE composer

operations.success_state: The transcript closes the active turn and the activity rail records completion
operations.failure_state: The active turn closes with a visible bounded error and remains retryable

operations.success_state: The tool card becomes complete and exposes a bounded result summary
operations.failure_state: The tool card becomes failed or rejected without silently executing another action

operations.success_state: Accepted hunks are written atomically and the proposal status becomes applied
operations.failure_state: The source file remains unchanged and a stale or invalid proposal stays reviewable

operations.success_state: The selected session and workspace revision replace the visible snapshot together
operations.failure_state: The current session remains active and a visible error explains the failed load

terminal.resize_behavior: Every resize recomputes pane geometry; undersized terminals show a recoverable compact surface with hidden actions disabled
terminal.color_mode: Color follows terminal capability with explicit monochrome, ANSI, indexed, and true-color projections
terminal.unicode_fallback: ASCII output preserves labels and single-cell layout when the terminal profile cannot render the preferred Unicode marks
terminal.non_tty_behavior: The launcher exits before initialization with a plain diagnostic and directs users to the line-oriented chat command

platforms: Windows through a compatible console host
minimum_sizes: 40 columns by 10 rows is the tested absolute minimum
80 columns by 24 rows is recommended for Agent
100 columns by 28 rows is recommended for IDE
smaller sizes use the recovery surface

verification.cleanup_test: A Unix PTY integration test launches the production runTUI boundary, waits for actual mode-entry bytes, sends Ctrl+Q, and requires a bounded clean exit plus restoration of alternate-screen, cursor visibility/color, focus-reporting, bracketed-paste, and configured mouse state; Windows/ConPTY is outside this Unix PTY evidence
